Methods

ChangeFocus(Drawable?)

Changes the currently-focused drawable. First checks that potentialFocusTarget is in a valid state to receive focus, then unfocuses the current osu.Framework.Input.InputManager.FocusedDrawable and focuses potentialFocusTarget. potentialFocusTarget can be null to reset focus. If the given drawable is already focused, nothing happens and no events are fired.

bool ChangeFocus(Drawable? potentialFocusTarget)

Parameters

potentialFocusTarget Drawable?

The drawable to become focused.

Returns

bool

True if the given drawable is now focused (or focus is dropped in the case of a null target).

TriggerFocusContention(Drawable?)

Reset current focused drawable to the top-most drawable which is osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.RequestsFocus.
